verdict.rationale: E2B documents first-party self-hosting (deployed with Terraform) and BYOC deployments, so a user can run sandboxes, and keep their data, on infrastructure they choose. There is no documented region selector or data-residency statement for the managed cloud, and the location benefit is implied by the deployment model rather than stated. Missing for 10: region selection for the hosted service, explicit data-residency documentation or guarantees, details on which regions or clouds BYOC supports, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Read the self-hosting guide to learn how to set up the E2B infrastructure on your own. The infrastructure is deployed using Terraform.
If you need an explicit configuration — for example several API keys, teams, or BYOC or self-hosted deployments — create an `E2B` client and use the resources it exposes.
